title: Figure 51: acoustic pressure magnitude contours at 10,000 Hz in water
description: ANSYS 12.1 contour plot of the magnitude of pressure (Pa) for 10,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Pressure localized at the source corner of the quarter-circle domain; legend 144 to 7267 Pa. Part of the BAASS frequency sweep of the radiating-sphere acoustic model.
